summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Superadmin → Client Payments feature. All 11 backend pytests passed and every frontend assertion from the review request was verified against the live preview app.

backend_verification.GET /api/admin/client-payments: 200 for superadmin, 401 unauthenticated, 403 for pro@axiom.ai. Shape includes metrics, attention, rows, stripe_mode. QA Trial Bakery LLC → status=trialing, cadence=annual, amount_cents=99000, next_charge_at==trial_end, enterprise_name=CypherPro. QA Late Plumbing Inc → status=past_due, last_failure present, ltv_cents=15800. QA Steady Dental PC → status=active, ltv_cents=19000. metrics.mrr_cents=11700, metrics.past_due=1, metrics.past_due_cents=7900, metrics.trialing=1. attention[0]=QA Late Plumbing Inc.
backend_verification.GET /api/admin/client-payments/{id}: QA Steady Dental PC detail returns 5 payments newest first with product_label 'Core'. Timeline includes 'Company created' and 'Paid $38.00' entries. 404 returned for unknown id.
backend_verification.POST /api/admin/client-payments/backfill: 200 OK, response has synced/failed/total keys. All seeded sub_qa_* ids reported in `failed` list (expected), no 500.

frontend_verification.sidebar: Sidebar renders 'Client Payments' link under Superadmin section and navigates to /admin/client-payments.
frontend_verification.attention_strip: cp-attention shows '1 client needs attention' with QA Late Plumbing Inc first.
frontend_verification.filters: Status=trialing → 1 row ('1 of 7'). Plan=assistant → QA Late Plumbing Inc. Search='dental' → QA Steady Dental PC. Enterprise=CypherPro → QA Trial Bakery LLC.
frontend_verification.drawer_trial_bakery: cp-drawer opens, cp-drawer-name='QA Trial Bakery LLC', cp-drawer-plan shows 'AI Bookkeeper · annual · $990/yr', card 'Visa •••• 4242', next charge Oct 8 2026 · $990. URL param ?client= set and removed on close via cp-drawer-close.
frontend_verification.drawer_dental: cp-drawer-payments has 5 rows each with Receipt link (Core · monthly · $38). cp-drawer-timeline renders Company created + 5 Paid $38.00 entries.
frontend_verification.sync_and_stripe_link: cp-sync-btn POSTs backfill (returns 200, failures expected for fake subs, no crash). cp-open-stripe href = https://dashboard.stripe.com/subscriptions.
frontend_verification.regression: /pro/clients still loads with Clients/Enterprises/Partners tabs (Enterprise view accessible).

critical_code_review_comments: admin_client_payments.py is clean (218 lines), uses async DB, no _id leakage, proper 404/503 error codes, role-guarded via require_role('superadmin').

Minor: /api/admin/client-payments/backfill iterates subscriptions sequentially via asyncio.to_thread - acceptable for current scale but could be parallelized with asyncio.gather if subscription count grows large.
Minor: _amount_cents hard-codes a 3000 override for simple_start with billing_discount - consider pulling this from PLAN_MONTHLY_CENTS to centralize pricing.
test_credentials: Superadmin admin@axiom.ai / admin123, Pro pro@axiom.ai / pro123 (both verified working).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing QA companies: QA Trial Bakery LLC, QA Late Plumbing Inc, QA Steady Dental PC.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_admin_client_payments.py in /app/backend/tests covers list/detail/backfill endpoints and metric assertions - reuse as regression. Frontend data-testids all follow cp-* convention and are stable.
rca of the issue: No issues found; feature functions as specified.
